questions.question_en: In India, which of the following review the independent regulators in sectors like telecommunications, insurance, electricity, etc.? 1. Ad Hoc Committees set up by the Parliament; 2. Parliamentary Department Related Standing Committees; 3. Finance Commission; 4. Financial Sector Legislative Reforms Commission; 5. NITI Aayog.
questions.language_status: English structured extraction; Telugu not included in index
questions.explanation_en: Parliamentary Department Related Standing Committees and NITI Aayog review independent regulators.
